post.summary:
Queues an ingest run; the queue's running marker answers 409 while
one is in flight (T028)

CreateManualLeadData.description:
Manual lead intake (spec FR-20): company name + URL + operator note.
Country is unknown at this point — enrichment backfills it.
CreateManualLeadData.title: CreateManualLeadData

DecisionRuleData.description:
Decision-rule write (plan §5 `DecisionRuleData`): sample, window and
rate thresholds. Locked before measuring (FR-19); locked rows are
immutable — only a new version for a new period.
DecisionRuleData.title: DecisionRuleData

GenerateDraftData.description:
Draft request (plan §5 `GenerateDraftData`): optional posting, variant,
language and selector-chosen provider/model (validated vs catalog).
GenerateDraftData.title: GenerateDraftData

SuppressData.description: Suppression intake (spec FR-17): canonical domain + reason.
SuppressData.title: SuppressData

UpdateAiSettingsData.description:
AI default change (plan §5 `UpdateAiSettingsData`). Catalog membership
and credential availability are enforced in the handler (422).
UpdateAiSettingsData.title: UpdateAiSettingsData

UpdateChannelData.description:
Channel re-verification (spec US-12, plan §5 `UpdateChannelData`):
a channel that no longer exists is marked `broken` and stops being
recommended. No other transition exists.
UpdateChannelData.title: UpdateChannelData

UpdateOutreachData.description:
Outreach mutation (plan §5 `UpdateOutreachData`). `operator_id` is
deliberately absent: the server always stamps the authenticated user,
never client input (FR-41).
UpdateOutreachData.title: UpdateOutreachData

UpdateProfileData.description:
Operator-tunable profile fields (spec US-1 CA-6): weights, languages,
minimum rate and target countries. Every save mints a new profile
version; later scores record which version they used.
UpdateProfileData.title: UpdateProfileData

UpdateSourceData.description:
Source tuning (spec US-2): status, frequency and the terms-review stamp.
Activating without reviewed terms is rejected in the handler (422) and by
the DB CHECK — never trust the client (spec FR-13).
UpdateSourceData.title: UpdateSourceData

UpsertContactData.description:
Manual decisor upsert (spec US-11, plan §5 `UpsertContactData`).
Excluded/ambiguous titles are rejected in the handler (422); the email
must live on the company domain; opposed people answer 409.
UpsertContactData.title: UpsertContactData

UpsertOpportunityData.description:
Opportunity write (spec US-6, plan §5 `OpportunityData`). Several
opportunities can hang off one contact (trial first, then retainer).
UpsertOpportunityData.title: UpsertOpportunityData

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
